processing.description: Read the monthly mean column (average) of co2_mm_mlo.csv, created by NOAA on 5 September 2026. The vintage is the year and month of that creation date, which is how NOAA labels its versions.

Kept every month as published. Where NOAA's own markers say something about a month (a Scripps-era value, a month with no measurement days that NOAA interpolated, a month without a standard deviation, or a month measured at Maunakea after the 2022 eruption) the observation carries that as a note. The deseasonalized, days, standard deviation and uncertainty columns are not published.

scope.basis: Dry-air mole fraction; monthly means of daily means, as published (not deseasonalized).
scope.geography: Mauna Loa Observatory, Hawaii (19.5° N, 155.6° W)

title: Carbon dioxide at Mauna Loa, monthly mean
